defs.def: a person whose job is to keep the records or accounts in an office, shop/store, etc. 职员；簿记员；文书

ex.s: Bill: Working as a clerk at my dad's insurance firm?
ex.t: 比尔：在我爸爸的保险公司当职员？

ex.s: (He gives the clerk the bank note.
A few years later, one of my sisters got married to a clerk—a man whom I suspect to have seen the letter—and my family celebrated by going on a rare holiday together.
ex.t: 几年后，我的一个姐妹嫁给了一个职员--我怀疑他看过这封信--和我的家人一起庆祝了一个罕见的假期。

ex.s: After two years of looking for work as a teacher, Einstein took a job as a clerk in the Swiss patent office.
ex.t: 在找了两年的教师工作后，爱因斯坦在瑞士专利局找到了一份文员的工作。

defs.def: an official in charge of the records of a council, court, etc. （议会、法院等的）书记员
柜台的售货员给我少找了零钱。
a person whose job is dealing with people arriving at or leaving a hotel 旅馆服务台接待员
